name: Woburn
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Woburn, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Woburn, MA: Festival on the Common with Santa and a Polar Express ride, a character holiday party and free library storytimes.
lede: Woburn starts Christmas the Saturday after Thanksgiving with the Festival on the Common, when Santa takes wish lists and the mayor reads 'Twas the Night Before Christmas before the Common lights up.
celebrates: The City of Woburn calls its Festival on the Common a family fun night in Woburn Center. Live Christmas and holiday music fills the evening, a Polar Express with live entertainment runs in the afternoon, and Santa meets every child to collect wish lists. After Mayor Concannon reads 'Twas the Night Before Christmas, the Common is lit for the season. The Woburn Guild of Artists holds a free art show at the First Baptist Church, ice carvers work through the event, and local groups sell festive drinks and snacks. Through December, the Woburn Public Library Children's Room adds free holiday storytimes for little ones.
lastyear: In 2025 Woburn held its 31st annual Festival on the Common on Saturday, November 29, from 3 to 6:30 pm on the Common, and the City posted traffic notices for the road closures around Woburn Center that afternoon. The festival flyer that year featured a Polar Express train ride. Making Magic Character Performers also hosted a holiday party with Woburn Recreation, which returns in 2026 as its third annual party.
facts: The Festival on the Common reaches its 32nd year in 2026, which means Woburn has gathered on the Common the Saturday after Thanksgiving since the mid 1990s. The lighting of the Common does not happen with a simple switch: it follows the mayor's reading of 'Twas the Night Before Christmas. Woburn's other big holiday tradition is football. On Thanksgiving 2026 Woburn and Winchester meet for the 125th time.
trains: Woburn sits on the MBTA Lowell Line. Anderson/Woburn station at 100 Atlantic Avenue is the city's Commuter Rail stop, with trains to North Station in Boston and up the line to Lowell, and the MBTA lists it on the Haverhill Line too. The Festival on the Common brings its own Polar Express ride to Woburn Center. For a real Christmas train, Edaville in Carver runs a holiday train through the lights, and Lowell, at the end of the line, has a streetcar museum.

faq: When is Woburn's Festival on the Common?

The Festival on the Common is held in Woburn Center on the Saturday after Thanksgiving each year. It runs in the afternoon and early evening with live holiday music, a Polar Express ride, Santa and the lighting of the Common. Check festivalonthecommon.com for the year's exact times before you go.
Where does Woburn light its Christmas tree?

Woburn lights the Common in Woburn Center during the Festival on the Common. The lighting comes right after the mayor reads 'Twas the Night Before Christmas, so families who want to see it should stay through the end of the evening program.
Can kids meet Santa in Woburn?

Yes. Santa is on duty at the Festival on the Common, meeting with all children to collect their Christmas wish lists. Character parties and photo events with local businesses add more chances, so check this page for the current year's Santa visits.
How do you get to Woburn by train?

Take the MBTA Lowell Line from North Station to Anderson/Woburn station at 100 Atlantic Avenue. The station has parking, and trains continue north to Wilmington, North Billerica and Lowell. Woburn Center is a short drive or bus ride from the station.
